channel.title: Hedera incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Hedera's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Hedera mainnet is still upgrading [resolved]
item.description: The problem that led to the extended outage has been resolved and the upgrade to 0.73.0 has been completed successfully. Release notes: https://docs.hedera.com/hedera/networks/release-notes/services#release-v0-73

item.title: Hedera Testnet smart contracts [resolved]
item.description:
The issue affecting Hedera Testnet Smart Contracts has now been resolved.
The update resolving the issue has been released to Testnet in v0.64.2.
https://status.hedera.com/incidents/fk8hvt7p3vhd
If you are experiencing any unexpected behaviour, please raise this on the Hedera Discord: https://hedera.com/discord
